The media provider mediaBroadcastOp requires a live multicamera streaming service to support 30,000 concurrent viewers. 
This system receives video streams from different angles, allows cloud mixing, adds advertising graphics, and distributes the signal to 
thousands of viewers simultaneously. The deployed service chain includes, in order: a <streamIngesterVF, 12> allocated at the edge, a <cloudStudioVF, 32> 
located in the cloud, a <graphicInjectorVF, 16> located in the cloud, and a <streamDistributorVF, 24> located in the cloud. Regarding requirements, 
compression is applied after the <streamIngesterVF, 12>. Furthermore, it is strictly required that the bandwidth from the <graphicInjectorVF, 16> to 
the <streamDistributorVF, 24> remains higher than 5000 Mbps. Additionally, the provider prefers that the total chain hardware is lower than 150 GB. 
Finally, caching is executed before the <streamDistributorVF, 24>.

the traffic is routed to a <streamDistributorVF, 24> located in the cloud, ensuring that caching is executed before it. For the entire deployment, 
it is ideally preferred that the total chain hardware remains lower than 150 GB.

The media provider vodStreamOp requires a video on demand distribution service to manage 80,000 active subscribers. 
This service optimizes movie delivery by encrypting content with DRM, compressing it into different formats, and storing it on 
nodes close to the user to avoid buffering. The deployed service chain includes, in order: a <drmEncryptorVF, 16> allocated in the cloud, 
a <transcoderVF, 32> allocated in the cloud, and a <cachingNodeVF, 12> node allocated at the edge. Regarding requirements, encoding is applied after 
the <drmEncryptorVF, 16>. Furthermore, it is strictly required that the bandwidth from the <transcoderVF, 32> to the <cachingNodeVF, 12> 
node remains higher than 10000 Mbps. Finally, the provider prefers that the <drmEncryptorVF, 16> and the <transcoderVF, 32> operate on the same node, 
while decoding is applied before the <cachingNodeVF, 12> node.

the chain includes a <cachingNodeVF, 12> node hosted at the edge. Finally, by ensuring that decoding is performed before the <cachingNodeVF, 12> at the edge, 
the system completes the video-on-demand distribution pipeline.

The media provider cinemaRenderOp requires a service to manage 5,000 rendering projects. This infrastructure receives raw digital scenes, 
distributes the rendering computation across hundreds of virtual nodes, and reassembles the finished frames for post-production. 
The deployed service chain includes, in order: a <sceneReceiverVF, 16> allocated at the edge, an <assetValidatorVF, 12> located in the cloud, 
a <renderDistributorVF, 32> located in the cloud, a <frameAssemblerVF, 24> located in the cloud, and a <colorGraderVF, 20> located in the cloud. 
Regarding requirements, compression is applied after the <sceneReceiverVF, 16>. Furthermore, the provider prefers that the total chain hardware 
remains lower than 800 GB. Finally, caching is executed before the <colorGraderVF, 20>.

The media provider liveSubsOp requires a live subtitling service to manage 10,000 concurrent streams. This service intercepts the audio of a 
streaming event, transforms it into text via AI, translates it into three languages, and reinserts it into the video feed as subtitles. 
The deployed service chain includes, in order: an <audioExtractorVF, 8> allocated at the edge, a <speechToTextVF, 32> function located in the cloud, 
a <multiTranslatorVF, 24> located in the cloud, and a <subtitleInjectorVF, 12> allocated at the edge. Regarding requirements, caching is applied after 
the <audioExtractorVF, 8>. Furthermore, the provider prefers that the total chain hardware remains lower than 100 GB. Finally, it is strictly 
required that the latency from the <speechToTextVF, 32> function to the <subtitleInjectorVF, 12> remains below 20 ms.

The enterprise provider corpDocOp requires a document classification engine to manage 50,000 daily files. This system analyzes PDF files or 
OCR scans, identifies the document type like invoice, contract, or reminder, and routes it to the competent business function. 
The deployed service chain includes, in order: an <ocrScannerVF, 16> allocated at the edge, a <textExtractorVF, 12> located in the edge, an <aiDocumentClassifierVF, 32> located in the cloud, a <dataRedactorVF, 16> located in the cloud, and adocumentRouterVF located in the cloud. Regarding requirements, 
security is applied after the <ocrScannerVF, 16>. Furthermore, it is a mandatory requirement that the <ocrScannerVF, 16> and the <textExtractorVF, 12> are deployed 
on the same hosting node. It is strictly required that the latency from the <textExtractorVF, 12> to the <aiDocumentClassifierVF, 32> remains below 50 ms. 
Additionally, privacy is executed before the <dataRedactorVF, 16>. Finally, the provider prefers that the bandwidth from the <aiDocumentClassifierVF, 32> to 
the <documentRouterVF, 8> remains higher than 500 Mbps.

The financial provider fraudSafeOp requires an antifraud analysis service to manage 200,000 transactions per hour. This system intercepts every digital 
payment request, compares it with habitual user spending patterns via machine learning, and authorizes the transaction in a few milliseconds. 
The deployed service chain includes, in order: a <requestInterceptorVF, 8> at the edge, a <profileMatcherVF, 16> at the edge, an <mlAnalyzerVF, 32> in the cloud, a <policyEnforcerVF, 12> 
in the cloud, and a <responseEmitterVF, 8> in the cloud. Regarding requirements, security is applied after the <requestInterceptorVF, 8>. Furthermore, it is strictly required 
that the <requestInterceptorVF, 8> and the <profileMatcherVF, 16> are deployed on the same hosting node. Privacy is executed before the <mlAnalyzerVF, 32>. Finally, the provider prefers 
that the bandwidth from the <mlAnalyzerVF, 32> to the <policyEnforcerVF, 12> remains higher than 1000 Mbps, and that the total chain hardware remains lower than 120 GB.

The financial provider hftGlobalOp requires a high frequency trading service to manage 500,000 orders. This infrastructure receives stock prices, 
executes decision algorithms, and sends purchase orders seeking the fastest network path. The deployed service chain includes, in order: a <marketFeedVF, 16> allocated at the edge, a <tradingAlgoVF, 32> allocated at the edge, a <riskCheckerVF, 16> located in the cloud, and an <orderDispatcherVF, 8> allocated at the edge. 
Regarding requirements, caching is applied after the <marketFeedVF, 16>. Furthermore, it is strictly required that the latency from the <marketFeedVF, 16> to the 
<tradingAlgoVF, 32> remains below 50 ms. The provider prefers that the bandwidth from the <tradingAlgoVF, 32> to the <riskCheckerVF, 16> remains higher than 5000 Mbps. 
Additionally, it is desired that the latency from the <riskCheckerVF, 16> to the <orderDispatcherVF, 8> remains below 5 ms. Finally, logging is executed before 
the <orderDispatcherVF, 8>.
